verdict.rationale: PayPal handles customer data and ships AI-facing services such as its MCP server, agent toolkit and agentic commerce, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy or control that keeps user data out of AI model training. The community items cover account limits, disputes and security responses, not AI training, so they do not bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
